# Duckpad 0.13.0
Edit multiple selections together, customize command shortcuts, and navigate matching text with an optional code minimap.
- Add cursors with Command-Option-click or make a rectangular selection with Option-drag. Edit > Multiple Cursors includes next/all occurrences, skip, undo the last added selection, cursors above/below, split into lines, and collapse to one cursor. Typing and Korean IME composition share the normal Undo/Redo history. Command-D remains Duplicate Line; assign occurrence commands in Keyboard Shortcuts. - Open Preferences > Keyboard Shortcuts, select a command and type a shortcut, or double-click its row. The row shows the previous and proposed shortcuts side by side. Enter applies, Escape immediately cancels, and conflicts identify the existing command. Bindings persist across launches and appear in menus and the command palette. Remove or restore individual bindings, or restore all defaults. - Highlight matching whole words at the caret and literal substrings when text is selected, including selecting `ap` inside `apple`. Matching positions appear in the scrollbar; explicit search results take priority. - Navigate with a compact, syntax-coloured minimap and flat scrollbar markers. Toggle View > Show minimap or the corresponding preference. Minimap scrolling preserves the caret, selection, and Undo history; narrow panes, binary documents, and progressive loading hide it automatically.
App and all helpers: **0.13.0 (61)**, upgrading **0.12.2 (60)**. Requires **macOS 13 or later**. Universal binaries support Apple Silicon and Intel. Existing settings, session recovery, document encodings, and the native plugin ABI remain compatible. The encoding and line-ending changes from 0.12.2 are included.
## Installation
Download `Duckpad-0.13.0-universal.dmg` and drag Duckpad into Applications, or extract `Duckpad-0.13.0-universal.zip`. Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
## Validation and limitations
The related Swift suites pass **177 test functions**, covering multi-selection input and IME Undo, occurrence scanning and search precedence, minimap navigation and bounded rendering, format-change Undo from 0.12.2, settings persistence, shortcut conflicts, and keyboard focus. The shortcut interaction was also exercised in an isolated application session. All eight localization catalogs (834 strings and four plural entries) are checked for missing keys and format arguments; shortcut layout is checked in all eight languages.
Bulk occurrence selection and line splitting are limited to 10,000 selections. Select All Occurrences also requires a document no larger than 16 MiB and a selected pattern no larger than 64 KiB. Exceeding a limit sounds an alert and leaves the original selections intact, without installing a partial set.
Shortcut capture requires Command or Control; key chords and shortcuts intercepted by macOS are not supported. Occurrence decoration is bounded to 100,000 matches and skips multiline, whitespace-only, rectangular, and over-256-byte selections. The minimap shows logical lines and samples up to 256 styled UTF-8 bytes per line.
Full manual UI inspection in all eight languages, the entire test suite, physical Intel hardware, and macOS 13 were not exercised. The universal Release build, bundle/resource/signature validation, and isolated Finder/Open With, bookmark-recovery save, window resizing, and sandboxed XPC extension/isolation smoke checks pass. Native save-panel UI automation was skipped.
The distribution is ad-hoc signed, without Developer ID signing or Apple notarization.
Release source: `d39d4edb88ea4f5dc44f6c5b25510eddd21031b2` ([PR #83](https://github.com/namJeongwan/duckpad/pull/83)).
